product: See which chunks support each ai_search answer (Beta)
tagline: You can now turn on the generate citations option in the ai search function to see which retrieved chunks the model used to support each answer it generates.

why_it_matters: Use ai search to enrich operational data with relevant context at scale, build batch retrieval augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, or expose retrieval as a tool to a compound AI system — all from a single SQL function call.
